about: The fewest passing titles scripts/loam-exit-check.mjs --phase 5 --milestone a accepts for each of milestone A's rows (phase 5 specification, section 18), by the place its row names, so an exclude, a skipped suite or a deleted file cannot pass unnoticed.

These counts are placeholders, each 1, and `placeholder` lists `a`, so the check fails on them whatever the runs show. Step 8 dispatches loam.yml, ci.yml and loam-desktop.yml on main, runs the check on the three runs with --print-minimums, copies the counts it prints here, removes `a` from `placeholder` (the field itself once no milestone is listed) and records the runs in `observed`.

After that, when exit tests are added or removed on purpose, run the check on runs that have them with --print-minimums and copy the counts it prints here in the same pull request, saying why each changed.
observed: No run yet: step 8 sets these counts from its manual runs
